vo.en: The loudest people often know nothing.
vo.fr: Les plus bruyants en savent moins.

visual.description: A man speaking animatedly into a microphone in front of a blurred crowd.

vo.en: It's called the Dunning-Kruger effect, a mental glitch where incompetence breeds extreme confidence.
vo.fr: C'est l'effet Dunning-Kruger, un biais mental où l'incompétence génère une confiance extrême.

visual.description: Abstract animation of mechanical gears turning inside a stylized human head.

vo.en: Beginners hit the 'Peak of Mount Ignorant,' feeling like masters because they don't know what they're missing.
vo.fr: Les débutants atteignent le 'Sommet de l'ignorance', se croyant experts car ils ignorent leurs lacunes.

visual.description: A man standing triumphantly on a small rocky hill looking out at a horizon.

vo.en: But as you learn more, you realize how deep the rabbit hole goes, and your confidence crashes.
vo.fr: Mais en apprenant, tu réalises l'étendue du sujet, et ta confiance s'effondre.

visual.description: A man sitting at a desk surrounded by high stacks of books looking overwhelmed.

vo.en: True experts actually underestimate themselves, assuming everyone else finds the work just as easy as they do.
vo.fr: Les vrais experts se sous-estiment, pensant que tout le monde maîtrise le sujet aussi bien qu'eux.

visual.description: Close up of hands performing a highly skilled craft like watchmaking or wood carving.

vo.en: Wisdom isn't about having all the answers, but acknowledging how much you still have to learn.
vo.fr: La sagesse n'est pas d'avoir toutes les réponses, mais d'admettre tout ce qu'il reste à apprendre.

visual.description: A person looking through a telescope at a vast starry night sky.

vo.en: So next time someone speaks with total certainty, remember that...
vo.fr: Alors quand quelqu'un parle avec une certitude absolue, souviens-toi que...

visual.description: A man walking calmly through a busy city sidewalk disappearing into the crowd.
